review.notes: Two iron-banded oak posts under a braced double lintel; the walkway the prompt asked for is missing. Turned 90° so its span runs along x. It spans a 7.5 m gateway at 1.31 times its width, and Chapters I–III's 12.5 m ones at its 1.35 limit, centred on the road with open ground either side.
